st.t: Talk to Redbeard Frank in Port Sarim.
Talk to one of the Seamen on the docks in Port Sarim to go to Musa Point.
Talk to Zembo in the Karamja Wines, Spirits and Beers bar. Buy one Karamjan rum.
Pick 10 bananas nearby, and then talk to Luthas about working for him.
s: Could you offer me employment on your plantation?
Will you pay me for another crate full?

st.t: Use the Karamjan rum on the crate outside the south-east corner of Luthas's hut, not the crate in the bedroom.
Long-press the crate outside and choose Fill to add the rest of your bananas, then talk to Luthas.
Talk to Luthas and tell him you finished filling the crate.
Head back to Port Sarim. Pay the Customs Officer to sail there.
s: Thank you, I'll be on my way
Can I journey on this ship?
Search away, I have nothing to hide.
Search away. I have nothing to hide.

st.t: Grab the white apron from the Fishing Shop.
Wear your white apron and talk to Wydin in the Port Sarim food shop to get a job. Then search the crate with the banana on it in the back room.
s: Well, can I get a job here?

st.t: Bring the Karamjan rum to Redbeard Frank in Port Sarim.
s: Ok thanks, I'll go and get it.

st.t: Climb up the stairs in The Blue Moon Inn in Varrock.
Open the chest by using the key on it.

Go to Falador Park and find the statue of Saradomin in the middle. See where it points: the dirt there makes a rough X. Stand in the middle of the X and dig. Kill the Gardener (level 4) who appears, or run out of the park to lose him, then dig again in the same spot.
